title: क्या दाम लगाया था
caption: राकेश को याद नहीं था कि पिछले महीने उसने क्या दाम लगाया था। संस्थापक उसकी कहानी सुनाते हैं।
linkedin_text: In ScoreMyBiz a list of what the owner sells and buys, with the last selling rate and last cost, grows by itself from every Sold and Bought entry and bill with items. He can add, change or hide items. It is a price list, not stock counting.

cast.rakesh: Rakesh, a stocky middle-aged Indian building materials dealer in a white shirt with rolled sleeves, a yellow site cap on his head

scenes.clip: the founder, a young Indian man with a short beard in a navy suit and striped tie, facing the camera in a building materials yard with stacked bags and sand behind him, a warm smile.
scenes.vo: नमस्ते। यह राकेश की कहानी है। एक ग्राहक ने पूछा, पिछले महीने आपने मुझसे क्या दाम लिया था?
